SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] It appears that you have made a fatal mistake. 
Your destiny has reached a dead end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] ...I mean, it really felt that you have reached the 
absolute end of your life. Getting dumped by your 
girlfriend, loitering around arcades...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] ...Don't worry. This is merely just one possible 
outcome. If you are able to make the right choice, 
you definitely would've made it to the right ending.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] You're so helpless, so we'll help you out... So, what 
went wrong this time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Let's see... If I can be direct, perhaps you were 
rushing things within the relationship?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, no wonder. This heroine is a shy person who 
scares easily too~

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] What is that supposed to mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Anyway, being impatient is forbidden. So don't act 
with your instincts alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] ...Yes... The ceremony written down in the Destiny 
Record, it has to be followed step-by-step to be 
meaningful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] If you wish to draw towards your desired fate, 
then think about your actions with discretion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Now then, lost traveler in the crossroads of fate, 
bear our advice to heart, head towards the point of 
selection once more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT: [FI] ...Well in any case, do your best.
